ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm unveiled a 5GHz Oryon CPU for its next-generation flagship Snapdragon platform. Apple launched its M6 chip on TSMC's 2nm process with 30% AI GPU compute boost versus M5, while the M5 Ultra combines four dies.
key_facts: Qualcomm: 5GHz Oryon CPU for next-gen Snapdragon
Apple M6: 2nm process (TSMC), 30% AI GPU compute boost vs M5

implications.text: 2nm adoption in mobile flagship SoCs signals acceleration of advanced node penetration from foundry leaders.
CPU frequency (5GHz) and GPU compute improvements (30%) represent continued architectural optimization at node maturity.

ko.counterpoint: Headline data lacks detail on M5 Ultra die count, yield, or cost implications; Oryon performance specifications versus competing platforms unavailable.
